results.title: Niger Gets First Algerian Fuel Shipment, Escorted by Troops - Bloomberg
results.snippet:
Niger received its first fuel shipment from Algeria, with 53 trucks escorted by troops from both countries arriving in the northern city of Agadez, as the two African neighbors deepen energy and security ties.
